purpose: Store Master Tung point records separately from standard 361 acupuncture points. This keeps Tung zones, reaction areas, Dao Ma combinations, and clinical indications searchable without mixing them into WHO-standard point codes.

content_policy.private_study: Use professional references, class notes, and web sources for learning and structure.
content_policy.public_ready: Rewrite in original English, cite sources, mark review status, and avoid copying full point pages or premium course material.
content_policy.clinical_safety: Needling, bloodletting, Dao Ma combinations, and reaction-area interpretation require professional training and source review before clinical use.
